name: society-management
description: Documentation toolchain for the Society Management codebase (28 module identities).

scripts.docs:api: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path');const walk=d=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):[path.join(d,e.name)]):[];const mods=['src','tests'].flatMap(walk).filter(f=>path.basename(f).startsWith('file_')&&f.endsWith('.js'));mods.forEach(f=>{const norm=f.split(path.sep).join('/');const id=path.basename(f,'.js').replace('file_','mod_');const rel=norm.startsWith('src/')?'docs/api-reference/'+norm.slice(4):'docs/api-reference/tests/'+norm.slice(6);const page=rel.slice(0,rel.lastIndexOf('/')+1)+id+'.md';if(!fs.existsSync(page))return;const md=cp.execSync('jsdoc2md --configure jsdoc.json --files '+f,{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();const cur=fs.readFileSync(page,'utf8');const a='<!-- jsdoc2md:START -->',b='<!-- jsdoc2md:END -->';const i=cur.indexOf(a),j=cur.indexOf(b);if(i<0||j<0||j<i)return;fs.writeFileSync(page,cur.slice(0,i+a.length)+'\n'+md+'\n'+cur.slice(j));});"
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:diagrams && npm run docs:pdf
